{"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Lula treated force as the preferred first option in any major crisis I searched. The 2024 record I found is dominated by:
- dialogue,
- ceasefire proposals,
- multilateral mediation,
- and explicit anti-escalation language.

So the evidence base supports a clear yes on 2B.1, with the main caveat being that some of Lula’s rhetoric was confrontational and one peace initiative drew serious criticism from Ukraine.","evidence":[{"title":"Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"February 21, 2024","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm","summary":"Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken, and Planalto separately reiterated his desire for peace and an end to the conflicts. This is direct evidence that he preferred diplomacy when peaceful channels were available.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.1","1B.8"]},{"title":"Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"May 23, 2024","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm","summary":"The joint statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for conditions to resume direct talks and move toward a comprehensive ceasefire. That is strong evidence against force-first instincts.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York","publisher":"Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"September 24, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york","summary":"Lula warned that nuclear arsenals and destructive weapons were pushing the world toward confrontation and said direct dialogue was crucial. In crisis terms, that is a clear preference for de-escalation over force.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.1","1B.2","1B.8"]},{"title":"President Lula's speech at the Summit of the Future opening in New York","publisher":"Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"September 22, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york","summary":"Lula said the world could not go back to living with nuclear threats and tied his warning to arms-race criticism and multilateral reform. This reinforces a pattern of preferring diplomatic off-ramps.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.1","1B.2","1B.8"]},{"title":"Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"February 23, 2024","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm","summary":"Lula repeated the genocide accusation and defended Palestinian statehood, triggering a major diplomatic rupture. This is the main cautionary item, but it is still rhetoric and diplomacy-breaking, not evidence that he preferred force over peaceful alternatives.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.2","1B.8"]},{"title":"Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"September 12, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966","summary":"Zelenskiy said Kyiv was not included and that the proposal lacked respect for Ukraine’s territorial integrity. This weakens the good-faith quality of the initiative, though it still points to de-escalation rather than force-first behavior.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]}]}
